description:
Our new terminal theme uses a subtle dark background of **#0a0a0a** with a foreground shade of **#e0e0e0**, and the overall style is set to **darker** details. The accent is a horizontal gradient that blends **#ff7f50** on the left into **#1e90ff** on the right, giving a vibrant pop without overwhelming the workspace. For a touch of personality we’ve added a background image called **galaxy.png** at an opacity of **30 %**.

The terminal color palette follows the classic eight‑color scheme. In the “bright” set the colors are: black **#4d4d4d**, red **#ff6e6e**, green **#5fff5f**, yellow **#ffff5f**, blue **#6e6eff**, magenta **#ff6eff**, cyan **#5fffff**, and white **#ffffff**. The “normal” set uses the standard hues: black **#000000**, red **#ff0000**, green **#00ff00**, yellow **#ffff00**, blue **#0000ff**, magenta **#ff00ff**, cyan **#00ffff**, and white **#ffffff**.
